violations.description: Food supplies. — --Food item was adulterated, contaminated or unsafe for human consumption. -Ice build up in box of corn at bottom shelf in walk in freezer. *Directed staff to dispose of product.
General food protection. — --Food item was not protected from potential contamination. -Condensation drip from fans in walk in freezer drip onto cases of food.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Ice scoop laying in ice at server station ice bin.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — ---Mashed potatoes made and cooled yesterday were date marked with today's date instead of yesterday's. *Staff corrected while on-site.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Peppers and onions chopped yesterday were not date marked. -Prime Rib made last Saturday did not have date mark on product.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. -Small portion of prime rib dated 9/25 found in walk in cooler.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Carbon debris in bottom of pizza oven. -Crumb debris at bottom interior of upright "fryer" freezer. -Crumb debris at bottom interior of stainless pizza freezer. -Frost build up at back edge of outdoor chest freezer. -Black debris at light switch cover in dry storage room.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Cottage cheese, mandarin oranges, chopped tomatoes and chopped peppers in cookline refrigerator were not date marked. -Portion items (i.e. taco meat, hash browns, etc.) in cook line make table were not date marked. -Buffet items (i.e. potato salad, coleslaw) in back refrigerator were not date marked. -Whole baked potatoes and prime rib in walk in cooler were not date marked.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Dust/debris at top of cook line refrigerator. -Grease/residue at pizza oven front and handle. -Flour/debris build up at underside of handles at 2 door stainless refrigerator.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Single use trays on top of glass door cooler are not stored inverted.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. -Phone left on table next to prep sink on cook line. -Jacket on top of back prep area table top. COS-both items were removed.
